meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按语法结构定位并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要按语法结构跨文件搜索和改写代码,而非靠纯文本匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Locate and batch-rewrite code by its syntax shape.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and transform code structures across many files, not just exact string matches.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 遇到“按代码形状查找或改写”的需求时，会用 ast-grep 按语法树而非文字来匹配代码；可先预览改动再批量改写，也能运行 YAML 规则等。支持 25 种语言。
howto.when: 当目标是代码形状而非文字时触发，例如按 AST 找同形态函数、跑 codemod 或扫描规则；纯文本场景不触发。

say.text: 找出项目里所有 console.log 调用，列出文件和行号
say.note: 会先对模式做离线校验，再执行结构搜索。

say.text: 把每个 console.log 改成 logger.info，先预览再应用
say.note: 默认只输出预览，确认后才改写文件。

say.text: 扫描 src 目录，运行 no-console 规则并汇报违规点
say.note: scan 会按项目配置执行规则并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude handles shape-based code find/rewrite with ast-grep, matching by syntax tree, previewing before bulk rewrite, and can run YAML rules. Supports 25 languages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the target is code shape, not text: e.g., finding functions of a shape via AST, running a codemod, or scanning rules. Plain-text targets do not trigger.

say_en.text: Find all console.log calls in the project and list files and line numbers.
say_en.note: Runs the search subcommand with offline pattern validation.

say_en.text: Rewrite every console.log to logger.info, preview first then apply.
say_en.note: replace defaults to dry-run; files change only on apply.

say_en.text: Scan src, run the no-console rule, and report violations.
say_en.note: scan executes rules from the project config and reports.
